subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw continue carrying folder-backed encrypted snapshots and destructive restore in core after this PR fixes the safety blockers, or should core stay with local archive create/verify while broader backup/cloud restore remains plugin or umbrella-issue work?
rationale: The choice affects credential handling, snapshot storage format, destructive restore semantics, backup config surface, and whether optional cloud/off-machine backup belongs in core or ClawHub/plugin workflows.

options.title: Require Core Safety And Proof First
options.body: Keep the PR open but block merge until maintainers can review a rebased branch with fixed path/archive/restore safety, upgrade-safe config semantics, and real after-fix CLI proof.

options.title: Narrow Core Scope
options.body: Ask for a smaller core restore/export contract and move cloud-drive snapshot scheduling or off-machine backup to ClawHub/plugin packages.

options.title: Pause In Favor Of Umbrella Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch and route remaining native backup decisions through the broad backup/restore umbrella issue before accepting another implementation PR.

recommendation.title: Require Core Safety And Proof First
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but block merge until maintainers can review a rebased branch with fixed path/archive/restore safety, upgrade-safe config semantics, and real after-fix CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Related backup lifecycle review already routes the product/security scope decision through maintainer review, and steipete has recent backup docs/test history plus visible routing context.
